title: The Postcard of Junebug Creek Anew
author: P. M. Eastwick
blurb: Edmund Quintana, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the festival ends.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
